annotations.title: Judge career: promise, character and dated windows

description: The career verdict from the judgment core, the function the app chat answers from. One promise (present or weak; career is never denied) with a single 0-100 score, confirmed from the lagna, the Moon and the D10; its character (fields of work; setting: service or own business); the periods the chart ties to a rise or a change of role, in date order, from Vimshottari lords tied to the 10th house and its lord, lifted where selective in the chart (verdict.layers) by a Jupiter-Saturn double transit that holds from the lagna and the Moon together and by K.N. Rao's Chara dasha tied to the Amatyakaraka; three reasons and the main counter-reason with their sources; past windows to confirm. The windows are traditional indications, not predictions: measured on offices taken by European politicians born 1790 to 1950 by a method fixed in advance, they showed no reliable lift over an age-matched control (holdout +1.5 points, standard error 2.1, p 0.23). Give them in date order, without ranking them or implying a likelihood. verdict.confidence measures agreement of the chart's own factors, not the likelihood of any event. Never a guaranteed promotion or job; nothing is said about losing a job, a business failing, or income.
